notes:
- Iris Client runs on Linux and macOS. Same launcher, same instances, same in-game menu, same bundled pack.
- Signing in on Linux and macOS shows a short code to enter in your own browser, the way a console does. Nothing is typed into the launcher and it never sees your password.
- The macOS build is a real application bundle: drag it to Applications and it behaves like anything else there.
- On Linux the launcher can add itself to your applications menu from Settings.
- About no longer rolls the credits. It tells you what the program is and what your copy of it actually is: version, platform, runtime, and where its files live.
- The Designer rank is now Developer.
- Only the first ten accounts given the Tester rank keep it. Everybody else is a Player.
